accuracyFlags.claim: Section 04: 'Namadgi campgrounds are mostly free but require registration' and takeaway 'Namadgi sites are free but need registration'.
accuracyFlags.correct: Namadgi vehicle-based campgrounds (Honeysuckle, Orroral, Mount Clear) must be booked in advance and camping fees apply; max booking 7 consecutive days. Walk-in bush camping is allowed in much of Namadgi. Replace with 'booked online in advance, fees apply' (matches the page FAQ).
accuracyFlags.fix: Namadgi campgrounds are NOT free: booked in advance, fees apply, max 7 nights (ACT Parks)

accuracyFlags.claim: Section 08: 'The Cotter Reserve and Casuarina Sands offer day use and limited camping close to Canberra'.
accuracyFlags.correct: Casuarina Sands is day use only; camping and fires prohibited. Cotter-area camping is only at Cotter Campground (1691 Cotter Road, Stromlo): bookings essential, max 2 weeks in any 6, fireplaces, hot showers, potable water, flush toilets, no dogs.
accuracyFlags.fix: Casuarina Sands: no camping, no fires; Cotter camping only at bookable Cotter Campground (max 2 weeks in 6, no dogs)

accuracyFlags.claim: Section 06: 'Namadgi prohibits campfires entirely in most areas year round, and gas cookers are the practical option'; takeaway 'Namadgi prohibits most campfires'.
accuracyFlags.correct: Namadgi is one of 4 ACT protected areas where campfires are permitted: only in the constructed fireplaces provided, own firewood (collecting prohibited), never on Total Fire Ban days. Gas stoves allowed except on Total Fire Ban days.
accuracyFlags.fix: Namadgi campfires ARE allowed in provided fireplaces with own wood, never on Total Fire Ban days (ACT Parks)
